positions.title: Metrologist Technician
positions.description: A Metrologist Technician makes important contributions to ensure the satisfactory technical performance of architectural metrology.  For example, the metrologist technician is responsible to plan and make decisions about metrology setups in the field, and be able to economically and efficiently process datasets in the office.  Metrologist technicians are responsible to ensure satisfactory customer outcomes, including time and scheduling estimation for the completion of tasks; performing mobilizations and fieldwork with skill, and in a safe manner in accordance with safety policies of the company; and assuring customers receive the work products we promise, when we promise.
